How to play

Each round shows one real Grailed listing. Guess its sold price in US dollars.

You have five guesses. After each one you’ll see an arrow: ↑ means go higher, ↓ means go lower.

Yellow means you’re within 25%. Red means you’re more than 25% off. Land within 5% and you win.

Play as many rounds as you want.
